name: harmonyos-feature-implementation
title: HarmonyOS Feature Implementation
job_to_be_done: Implement and verify real HarmonyOS NEXT business features from frozen Android inventory and an accepted HarmonyOS scaffold, with source-first visual assets, state-level emulator evidence, native-capability adapters, and independent parity acceptance. Use only after migration Phases 1–3 pass; do not use it for scaffold creation, Android discovery, or release-store submission.

trigger_surface.description: Implement and verify real HarmonyOS NEXT business features from frozen Android inventory and an accepted HarmonyOS scaffold, with source-first visual assets, state-level emulator evidence, native-capability adapters, and independent parity acceptance. Use only after migration Phases 1–3 pass; do not use it for scaffold creation, Android discovery, or release-store submission.
should_trigger: 阶段3已通过，按 Android 清单实现所有 ArkUI 功能和视觉一致性。
修复鸿蒙页面把 Android 新页面错误做成 Dialog 的一致性问题。
在模拟器逐状态验证 UI、跳转、运算、剪贴板和异常状态。
should_not_trigger: 分析 Android 项目有哪些页面和控件。
协调并执行完整的阶段1到4。
edge_cases: 重新设计这个鸿蒙应用，让交互更原生。
修复一个与 Android 迁移无关的鸿蒙 bug。
准备鸿蒙应用商店截图和发布说明。

steps: Verify Gates 1-3, freeze Phase 4 environments, and copy the accepted scaffold plus Android evidence and assets.
Issue one immutable feature work order with exclusive paths and distinct UI, business/data, native, verification, and acceptance roles.
Implement every migration unit without changing its carrier, components, functions, transitions, data effects, system effects, or source assets.
Build the exact snapshot and capture each required state with emulator commands, assertions, Inspector bindings, PNG, and side-effect evidence.
Route mismatches through bounded repair, obtain independent parity acceptance, and close only with canonical Gate 4 PASS.
decision_points: A page cannot become a Dialog and UI/function simplification is forbidden without explicit controller-approved parity difference.
Contradictory Android facts return to Phase 2; wrong scaffold placement returns to Phase 3.
Build success alone never grants parity; every seeded state and environment requires final evidence and review.
failure_modes: The model optimizes for native appearance by changing carriers, omitting controls, merging flows, or simplifying behavior.
Fake data, no-op adapters, placeholders, or unimplemented branches reach a passing build.
An implementer, verifier, or model self-approves a small page or state.
Assertions trust an external PASS string instead of comparing actual and expected observable behavior.
